current_date: 17 July 2017 ('Latest update - 17 July 2017'; same date on Checklists 2-4 and the A to Z Guide)
current_evidence: The council's 'Making an application' page links to Validation Checklists 1-4 and the A to Z Guide, all labelled 'Latest update - 17 July 2017'. The page mentions no newer list or consultation, and a web search found none.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured nothing for Full/Outline/Reserved Matters/s73. Its tab is empty and 'Req. items' is 4. Checklist 1, which covers those types, has a 26-item local list, with triggers in the A to Z Guide: Air Quality Assessment incl. dust/odour (in or next to an AQMA, or where dust/odour issues are likely); Biodiversity/Geodiversity Survey and Report (possible impact on biodiversity/geodiversity or protected species, incl. demolition, roof works, tree/hedge removal); CEMP (may be required for site preparation, demolition and construction); County Development Statement (all county Reg 3 developments); Daylight/Sunlight Assessment (possible adverse daylight impact; cast-shadow drawings for new buildings over 2 storeys near dwellings/workplaces); Economic Statement (significant investment or job creation/loss); Environmental Statement (EIA development); FRA and SuDS strategy (FRA for 1ha+ in FZ1 and new development in FZ2/3; drainage strategy for all major development); Foul Sewage and Utilities Assessment; Heritage Statement (possible impact on a designated heritage asset or its setting, or on known archaeological sensitivity); Land Contamination and Land/Slope Stability incl. Coal Mining Risk Assessment (contamination/instability known or suspected, vulnerable use, Coal Authority high-risk area); Landscaping details/LVIA (LVIA for large schemes or sensitive locations); Lighting Assessment (publicly accessible development with external lighting near housing, highways, listed buildings, conservation areas, open countryside or habitats); Mineral Development Statement (all mineral applications); Mineral Safeguarding Statement (inside an MSA or near mineral infrastructure); Noise Assessment (noise disturbance or noise-sensitive development); Open Space/Playing Pitch Assessment (development of open space/pitches); Planning Obligations Heads of Terms; Planning Statement (larger proposals); Site Waste Management Plan/Waste Audit (larger projects or significant waste); Statement of Community Involvement (scale/impact dependent); Structural Survey (substantial demolition or conversion); Transport, Access, Parking and Travel Plan (significant traffic generation; new school/nursery or 30+ pupil increase needs scoping); Tree Survey and Protection Plan; Waste Development Statement (waste applications); Waste Management Facility Safeguarding Statement.
issues.evidence: Checklist 1 'LOCAL LIST OF REQUIREMENTS'; A to Z Guide, e.g. 'A County Development Statement, which should accompany all planning applications for county developments'

issues.detail: Several application types say 'No specific local requirements identified ... national requirements only', although Checklist 1 explicitly covers them: Outline, Reserved matters and Variation of condition s73. Even the county-specific rows say this: 'Minerals & waste (county)' should carry the Mineral Development Statement, Waste Development Statement and Mineral/Waste Safeguarding Statements, and 'County own devt (Reg 3)' should carry the County Development Statement. All of these rows also cite Checklist 1 as their source.
issues.evidence: Checklist 1 heading: 'Applications for Full Planning Permission ... Outline ... Reserved Matters ... Removal or Variation of a Condition'

issues.detail: Grokbot read Checklist 3 (Prior Notification of Proposed Demolition) but captured nothing from it. Its local list requires: Biodiversity Survey and Report, County Development Statement, Location Plan, Site Plans and other plans/drawings/photographs, Planning Statement, Tree Survey and Protection Plan, and Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: Checklist 3: 'Applications for Prior Notification of Proposed Demolition' local list

issues.detail: The Discharge of conditions row labels 'Photographs / Photomontages' as a requirement. Its trigger is a run-together mash of form text: national-list wording, 'The Appropriate Fee (For the forms, fees and guidance click here)' and the form prompts 'The planning permission reference number is' / 'List the submitted details below'. Checklist 4's 'local list' is just these prompts (permission reference and conditions being discharged). It has no photomontage requirement.
issues.evidence: Checklist 4 local list: 'The planning permission reference number is'; 'List the submitted details below Identify the relevant condition'

issues.detail: The Lawful development cert rows have cut-off excerpts that start mid-sentence ('information (e.g. sworn affidavit(s)...', '/ Drawings / Photographs ...') and repeat the A to Z Guide boilerplate. 'Photographs / Photomontages' mislabels the source item 'Plans / Drawings / Photographs'. Checklist 2 lists three local items for both existing and proposed LDCs: LDC supporting information (e.g. sworn affidavits), Planning Statement, and Plans/Drawings/Photographs.
issues.evidence: Checklist 2 local list: 'Lawful Development Certificate (LDC) supporting information (e.g. sworn affidavit(s) from people with personal knowledge of the existing use)'; 'Planning Statement'; 'Plans / Drawings / Photographs'

issues.detail: Grokbot did not record the A to Z Guide as a source. It holds the actual triggers for every local list item, and the checklists point to it ('For advice on the requirements refer to our A to Z Guide'). Without it the extraction cannot capture any triggers.

summary: The link and the current list are correct: Checklists 1-4 and the A to Z Guide, dated 17 July 2017, are still current. Grokbot captured almost none of the content. It missed Checklist 1's 26-item local list, which covers Full/Outline/RM/s73, minerals, waste and Reg 3 applications, and the Checklist 3 demolition items. Its few LDC and discharge-of-condition rows are fragments or form prompts.
